description: Sidebar intent for a module, at either of the two layers a site has. `user` is what tells them apart: blank is the site layer, curated by a Workspace Manager and applying to everyone; a user's name is that person's own arrangement, which is applied on top and wins. The `Custom *` prefix elsewhere in this repo means site-owned override of app-shipped content, and this doctype knowingly overloads it: with the layers structurally identical there is nothing to gain from a second doctype, and `user` makes the layer unambiguous at a glance. Do not "fix" this by splitting it.

fields.description: Blank means the site layer, which applies to everyone and is overridden by each user's own arrangement.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Overrides the dock label for this module.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: One ordered list holding both references to base items (`added` unset -- non-empty fields override, empty fields mean no opinion) and items this layer added (`added` set -- full items, rendered as they stand). Row order is the arrangement; base items not named here keep their base order and follow the ones that are, which is how a newly installed app's items still reach someone who has already reordered.
fields.label: Sidebar Items
